title: The existing semilinear exchange cube comparison data
statement: For the finite-field datum and operation stages of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], with model spaces and geometric fibers of [def-pod-constructible-weil-model-squares], retain the following existing definitions, now in a prerequisite module. For commuting comparisons c_F:F⋙Q≅P⋙F and c_G:G⋙R≅Q⋙G, iterated is their whiskered composite with functor associators. Equivariant asserts c_F(K) α(PK)=Q(α(K)) c_G(K) and the induced equation for every invertible P-algebra structure. Comparisons supplies the pull, direct and compact-support Frobenius isomorphisms, retaining both model and geometric compactification indices. directExchange and compactExchange are the supplied exchange transformations conjugated by their endpoint identifications [def-exchange-projection]; changedExchange additionally conjugates by the canonical compactification comparisons. directComposition is the right-adjoint mate compositor and supportComposition is the specified support compositor transported across geometric-fiber functoriality. Laws is the conjunction of their exchange, composition and refinement equivariance equations and the two representative-change compatibility identities. rationalNormalized and commonNormalized require the actual pullback composition components [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], their direct-image mates, the canonical model-anchor proper/open Frobenius exchanges [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange], and conjugation to each geometric representative. Relabeling replaces a structural map a_W by g_W a_W in diagrammatic order, with the k-linear isomorphism given by g_W. All bodies, signatures, coefficient domains and anchor indices are exactly the existing ones; this node records the prerequisite interface and introduces no new operations.
